bpsc-online-application.text: The Bihar Public Service Commission came into existence on 1 April 1949, and its headquarters moved from Ranchi to Patna on 1 March 1951.

Its constitutional status was pronounced with the promulgation of Constitution of India on 26th January, 1950. It is a Constitutional Body under Article 315 of the Constitution of India. The Bihar Public Service Commission initially began its functioning for the State of Bihar with its headquarters at Ranchi. The State Government decided to shift the headquarters of the Commission from Ranchi to Patna and it was finally shifted to Patna on 1st March 1951

icai-examination-portal.text: ICAI announced that the Chartered Accountants Final Examination is held twice a year from the May 2026 examination onwards.
icai-examination-portal.source_quote: Chartered Accountants Final Examination to be held twice a year from May 2026 Examination onwards

icai-examination-portal.text: From May 2026, the CA exam form lets candidates choose a preferred exam centre directly, where they once picked only a zone or city.
icai-examination-portal.source_title: ICAI announcement on examination-centre selection, May 2026
icai-examination-portal.source_quote: unlike previous examinations where students selected only a zone or city, the online application form for May-2026 CA examinations will now provide the option to select the preferred exam centre in zone/city directly.

kerala-psc-one-time-registration.text: To apply for any Kerala PSC post, a candidate first creates a profile through One Time Registration.
kerala-psc-one-time-registration.source_title: Kerala PSC OTR Instructions to Candidates
kerala-psc-one-time-registration.source_quote: To apply for a notified post, you have to register and create a profile using One Time Registration

mpsc-online-application.text: On MPSC's online application system, profile creation is a one-time step after creating a user account.
mpsc-online-application.source_quote: Step 1: New User Registration / Create User Account (1st time user) 5 Step 2: Profile Creation (One time activity)

rpsc-online-application.text: RPSC launched One Time Registration on 10 January 2022.
rpsc-online-application.source_quote: On 10th January 2022, in the larger interest of candidates, the Commission launched the facility of One Time Registration of profile.

rpsc-online-application.text: With RPSC's One Time Registration, a candidate registers once on the recruitment portal and gets a unique registration number.
rpsc-online-application.source_quote: Now a candidate has to register once only on the recruitment portal to get a unique one time registration number.

uppsc-one-time-registration.text: A candidate's UPPSC OTR number is the only registration number used to apply for any post the Commission advertises.
uppsc-one-time-registration.source_quote: Applicant's OTR number is the only regsitration number for submitting application form against any post published by the commission.

uppsc-one-time-registration.text: UPPSC issues the OTR number instantly, and a candidate can apply for a post only after Lock and Final Submit.
uppsc-one-time-registration.source_title: UPPSC General Instructions for Online OTR Registration
uppsc-one-time-registration.source_quote: Candidate can get the OTR number instantly … Candidates can apply for the advertised post only after doing " Lock and Final Submit "
